away_injuries.comment: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.
James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.
Embiid has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Rockets due to right foot plantar fasciitis management, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.
Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
